recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片可見含大量脂肪空泡的骨髓顆粒與周邊造血細胞，左上角有一團深紫色、顆粒密集的細胞聚集，可能為肥大細胞群；但此倍率無法確認個別肥大細胞的形態，需高倍觀察梭形或低顆粒的異常肥大細胞。
features: Low-power aspirate showing marrow particles with numerous fat spaces
Hematopoietic cells lining fat spaces and scattered in the smear
Dense dark purple granular cluster at the upper left, possibly a mast cell aggregate within a particle
Individual cell granularity and shape not resolvable at this magnification
Background red cells in rouleaux-free monolayer
describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows marrow particles with abundant fat spaces and associated hematopoietic cells. A dense, dark purple, granular cluster at the upper left may represent an aggregate of mast cells within a particle, but individual cellular detail cannot be resolved at this magnification. Neoplastic mast cells in systemic mastocytosis are typically spindled, hypogranular or with eccentric nuclei and tend to be trapped in particles; high-power evaluation and flow cytometry for CD117+/CD25+ mast cells are required. The image is only partially informative for the stated diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are large cells with lobulated nuclei and pink granular cytoplasm rather than densely purple-black metachromatic granules.

ddx.dx: Reactive mast cells in hypocellular marrow
ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, well granulated and scattered singly, and are CD25-negative.
Precipitate is extracellular, irregular and lies on a different focal plane from cells.
